d:
Illegal Liquor : jharkhand men avaidh sharab ke karobar par lagam lagane ke lie dron kaimron se nigrani ki taiyari hai. janglon men chhipi sharab ki bhattiyon se lekar dur-daraj ke thikanon tak najar rakhi jaegi. iske lie kantrol rum se monitring hogi aur suchna milte hi kvik rispons tim (QRT) karravaee karegi.
Vibhag ka dava hai ki aadhunik taknik ki madad se avaidh sharab ke karobar par shikanja kasne men madad milegi. ab dekhna hoga ki dron nigrani aur tvarit karravaee ki yah vyavastha kitni prabhavi sabit hoti hai.
